# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 makes C# API documentation available directly alongside NuGet assemblies. Public API documentation now originates in the C# source and ships as compiler-generated XML sidecars, improving IDE help for package consumers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Chrome m154 renderer fixes adopted** — Updates the bundled Skia engine with upstream Chrome m154 corrections for rendering consumers. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with assemblies** — Public API documentation is maintained as C# XML comments and packaged beside managed assemblies, making it available to IDE consumers directly from NuGet packages. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
